### Power
Don't start with [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d), more value taking [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb) early rounds, especially against the specific comp in the video.

### Items
* [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) - Great base AP to make the orbs hurt in round 1 (and will be kept around most of the game). 
* [Shady Spectacles](item_ef9bb72f-a56c-4fb6-a552-5abce0b943d7) - Doubling up our survivability and taking full advantage of all the ability damage we're doing. You could optionally swap this out for [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) to make your right click do more damage (and lifesteam) or [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295) if you plan to ult a lot and stack more Ability Power. 
* [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) - Basically required as Moira has low base health. Armor is a bonus.

[Video Link (5:49)](https://youtu.be/1uZjlqJzVTY?si=ywikpUXu7ajrcPMB&t=349)

### Power
Pick up [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d) for this round. 

### Playstyle
At the beginning of the round, prime your output in spawn by using just under half your Biotic Energy and using a damaging [Biotic Orb](ability_721997d0-c151-4a4c-bb11-86552b14def6). This will allow [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d) to fire much quicker and ensure a damage orb is fired. 

[Alternative Energy](item_c3e816b3-9c39-4528-9578-e3fa610b6cc6) is basically required to maintain uptime of [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d) without relying on Biotic Grasp Secondary Fire. Instead, you refill your Biotic Energy every time you fade, which works well with [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb). This is especially important in the video due to the long range nature of the map and enemy team. 

### Items
* [Alternative Energy](item_c3e816b3-9c39-4528-9578-e3fa610b6cc6) - Attack Speed, Ability Power, refill Biotic Energy on fade for more [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d) procs.
* [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be) - Orbs damage enemies more, leading to more damage and more Ability Lifesteal.
* [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) - Attack Speed means we use Biotic Energy faster leading to more [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d) orb generation. 
* [Ballistic Buffer](item_40146dd3-a8cb-40ca-8917-c430bfa2be0e) - Called out as good against the Cassidy, and Arx was 300 cash short of affording [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6), which he may have kept instead for general armor.

[Video Link (11:21)](https://youtu.be/1uZjlqJzVTY?si=cQTkhmLDMCwPTCz0&t=681)

### Power
Our Power this round is [Deconstruction](item_cc8c46cc-b4a3-4c0f-aeb6-f7837e0e8e7c) which synergizes with [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d). When we use our Biotic Energy, we also trigger a damage bonus that will apply to the orb just fired and any other damage dealt for 6s. I sampled the round footage and for a 1 minute section, **damage was boosted ~74% of the time** (about 44 seconds during the 1 minute clip). 

### Playstyle
Given the money Arx had in the video, he opted for both debuff items and sold [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be) to afford it. He picks it back up in the following round, but between [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb), [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d), and the general [Biotic Orb](ability_721997d0-c151-4a4c-bb11-86552b14def6), there's a lot of orbs applying debuffs. 

Ability Power is still average here, so orbs are not as good as they will get, but the double debuff this round is worth it. 

### Items
* [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98) - Slowing the enemy team, affecting their positioning and movement, especially impactful against Genji, Junker Queen, and Brigitte. 
* [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) - Limit the effectiveness of healing, especially impactful against Junker Queen, and Brigitte. 

### Sell
* [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be) - Selling in favor of getting both [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98) and [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) to have greater impact on the team, limiting the movement of Junker Queen, Brigitte, and Genji, and the healing of Junker Queen and Brigitte. 
* [Ballistic Buffer](item_40146dd3-a8cb-40ca-8917-c430bfa2be0e) - No longer needed.

[Video Link (16:01)](https://youtu.be/1uZjlqJzVTY?si=16orjUUYuKhzb-oy&t=961)

### Playstyle
The primary focus of these items is to apply as many debuffs as possible to slow and reduce healing. [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be) and [Extendrils](item_138e73a2-6915-4ffc-bd89-029a85bf94b8) will be doing a lot of the work, but aiming orbs and our healing-triggered [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d) orbs to maximize bouncing off walls and around corners will maximize our damage and debuff output. 

### Items
* [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be) - Buying this back with the new money, still a huge value in the late game. 
* [Extendrils](item_138e73a2-6915-4ffc-bd89-029a85bf94b8) - Increasing orb range increases debuff application, Ability Damage output, and health restored by Ability Lifesteal. 
* [Energized Bracers](item_f83a1d9e-91f8-4d2c-bd62-c673b8d9fd2e) - Adds Ability Lifesteal, which with the volume of orbs will be substantial. 

### Sell
* [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) - Finally replacing this with Epic items. 
* [Shady Spectacles](item_ef9bb72f-a56c-4fb6-a552-5abce0b943d7) - Upgrading to [Energized Bracers](item_f83a1d9e-91f8-4d2c-bd62-c673b8d9fd2e) for Ability Lifesteal. 
* [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) - Small hit to our Attack Speed, but totally worth the slot.

[Video Link (20:20)](https://youtu.be/1uZjlqJzVTY?si=4ahOTtaAJUksRWxd&t=1220)

### Power
The final Power for the build is [Multiball](item_5d0e4135-f4e1-42fb-991a-417643064560) to even further improve our debuff coverage. The additional orbs from Multiball are much weaker, but our extremely high Ability Power and damage boost from [Deconstruction](item_cc8c46cc-b4a3-4c0f-aeb6-f7837e0e8e7c) are doing their best to bring up the damge. 

### Playstyle
The playstyle in this round is the same as before with the added orbs from [Multiball](item_5d0e4135-f4e1-42fb-991a-417643064560). Continue firing orbs intentionally to maximize their effect. 

### Items
* [Champion's Kit](item_8682f8c7-8811-439b-8d50-fa81cd43ddce) - Arx opts for maximum Ability Power because it's Quick Play, and I don't disagree. 

### Sell
* [Energized Bracers](item_f83a1d9e-91f8-4d2c-bd62-c673b8d9fd2e) - Forgoing survivability and healing output for raw damage here. Alternatively, [LumériCo Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) or [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) are decent options for still adding Ability Power while keeping some survivability.
